title: Just 10% Of Ocean Litter Keeps Fishing After Abandonment
hook: Fishing gear is 10% of litter, yet it keeps catching animals.
closing: Retrieving abandoned gear stops plastic that continues harming wildlife by itself.
question: Should gear retrieval be mandatory?

segments.say: Fishing gear makes up 10% of ocean litter. Unlike most trash, it keeps trapping animals after crews abandon it.
Lost fishing gear weighs 640,000 tons each year. Working equipment becomes an enormous recurring waste stream.
Fishing gear entangles 100,000 marine animals yearly. The danger continues long after the gear is lost.
